queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: One search per line. Each search is charged once.

searchDepth.title: Search depth
searchDepth.description: basic: the best passage from each page. advanced: up to three passages per page, reads pages longer (charged as an advanced search). fast: Google snippets only, no page reading.

maxResults.title: Results per search
maxResults.description: How many websites to return for each search (1-20). More than 10 reads a second Google page.

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: news favours recent news articles; finance favours financial sources.

includeDomains.title: Only these websites
includeDomains.description: For example example.com. Leave empty for the whole web.

excludeDomains.title: Never these websites
excludeDomains.description: Results from these websites are dropped.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code (us, gb, in, de...) to get that country's Google results.

includeFullPages.title: Include full page text
includeFullPages.description: Also return the full readable text of each page (long).
